reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: Measured 1.60 mm maps to each real layer, key thickness and carrier; proposed supported range 1.6–2.4 mm.
mapping.socket: Measured 4.50 × 1.70 mm slots inform original rectangular T-key sockets in exterior registration lugs. Key shaft width remains 4.50 mm; sockets are 4.50+clearance by sheet+clearance. Proposed total .10–.30 mm allowance, default4.65×1.75, not an assertion of identical source fit.
mapping.carrier: Real surrounding frame, four crossbars and 20 low runners. Proposed .4–.6 mm runner height and .8–1.2 mm width replace fragile .21–.22 mm source heights. Four per part; key runners attach to wide head sides, not shafts.
mapping.redesign: Original floor, open-channel core, beveled labium roof and two full-stack T keys. This is a laminated fipple/edge-tone experiment, not the source spaceship, a straw rack, membrane kazoo, or generic ported acoustic box. Windway feeds a rectangular chamber under a roof window; lip is .45–.8 mm thick, rising to full sheet over4mm.
mapping.personalization: Exact Boolean floor-lug engravings isolated from air paths and key sockets; preserve≥1mm backing. No hull substitution.
mapping.assembly: Three layers stack along Z; both keys lower through parallel sockets, broad heads seat on roof. Keys can lift out unless glued. Bond both core faces and keys; air sealing/sound untested.

sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.
